title: Nth Magical Number
summary: Identify the n-th number that is divisible by either a or b, ensuring the result is within the range of 0 to 10^9 + 6.
statement: Identify the n-th number that is divisible by either a or b, ensuring the result is within the range of 0 to 10^9 + 6.
constraints: A magical number is divisible by a or b.
Find the nth positive magical number in increasing order.
hints: Count magical values no greater than x by inclusion-exclusion using lcm(a,b).
This count is monotone, so binary-search its first value reaching n.
Use n*min(a,b) as a safe upper bound.
The lower-bound result is exactly the nth ordered magical number.
editorial: The lower-bound result is exactly the nth ordered magical number.

tests.explanation: The first value divisible by two or three is two.
The sequence begins 2,3,4,6, so return six.
